numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides bounded integer structural-mass accounting for candidate colony units without asserting measured fungal biomass.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proxy must not be converted into a real mass, inoculum amount, or production quantity.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Supports an exact candidate mass-volume consistency fixture without assigning physical dimensions.
numeric_parameters.risk: No conversion to cubic meters, colony area, or cultivation-space guidance is authorized.

numeric_parameters.rationale: A fixed ratio makes the candidate mass-volume identity deterministic.
numeric_parameters.risk: This is an accounting identity, not a biological or material density claim.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Bounds a sealed-compartment dispersal test and permits zero movement whenever any gate fails.
numeric_parameters.risk: The value is not a real dispersal distance, release radius, or cultivation instruction.

conservation_contract.structural_mass: Every substrate debit enters colony biomass, processed residual, inactive biomass, retained material, or named pending Ecology custody.
conservation_contract.moisture_water: Every moisture or water debit enters colony water, processed residual water, atmospheric proxy, inactive biomass water, retained custody, or named pending Ecology custody.
conservation_contract.nutrient_proxy: Every abstract nutrient debit enters colony stores, processed residual, inactive biomass, retained custody, or named pending Ecology custody; no chemistry or soil effect is inferred.
conservation_contract.energy_proxy: Every source debit enters colony stores, processed residual, inactive biomass, dissipation, or named pending Ecology custody.
